sam_support: FYI got a support ticket from @acme — they upgraded to py-sdk 1.10 and started hitting a TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'response_format'. They also report more 429s and retries not kicking in.

eli_sdk: Can you paste the minimal repro + pip freeze and which auth method they use?

sam_support: Customer pasted this snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(prompt="hi", response_format="json", timeout=10)
```
Stack: TypeError at redwood/sdk.py: unexpected keyword argument 'response_format'
pip freeze they sent: `redwood-sdk==1.10.0`, `requests==2.28.1`

maria_infra: Looks like in 1.10 we renamed `response_format` -> `formatting` and I forgot to leave a deprecation alias. Also we subtly changed retry/backoff defaults (which could explain the extra 429s). Not great.

eli_sdk: Quick mitigation for support to give customer: 1) Pin to 1.9.7: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.9.7` (restores previous behavior). 2) Or update call to new param name: `client.generate(..., formatting="json")`. 3) For 429s advise `max_retries=3` and `retry_backoff=1.5` while we patch.

sam_support: Sent those options. Customer says pinning to 1.9.7 makes the TypeError go away; they still saw occasional 429s but adding `max_retries=3` helped.

ci-bot: deploy/patch/1.10.1 scheduled -> https://ci.internal/builds/4567 :shipit: 

eli_sdk: I'll cut 1.10.1 today with a compatibility shim that maps `response_format` -> `formatting`, and revert the retry default change (or make it opt-in). Will also add a short migration note in changelog.

sam_support: Thanks — I'll update the ticket and ask customer to reopen if anything else pops up.

maria_infra: Sorry for the churn. We'll add a test to cover aliasing for common params in future releases.
